title: Systemic Game Design, Economy Loops & Emergent Interactions
core_competencies: Closed-loop economic balance: resources must never spawn infinitely without consuming an upstream commodity.
Emergent interactions: mechanics should function as generic verbs (Burn, Freeze, Wet, Electrify, Unlock, Bribe).
Dynamic price elasticity: Leontief input-output matrices where supply disruptions cascade across production chains.
Crafting as world interaction: crafting occurs physically at workstations (ovens, anvils, alembics), never inside detached menu abstractions.
anti_patterns: Adding static currency faucets without sink mechanics.
Designing siloed features that do not interact with other game rules.
Spawning items via arbitrary probability tables instead of physical origin points.
